methodology: Codex independently reopened each direct manager, company, SEC or regulatory source, verified the cited claim in the retrieved content, recorded access behavior, and hashed the retrieved bytes. FERC filing components were retrieved from the official eLibrary API and visually checked on the cited PDF pages. Search-result snippets were not treated as evidence.

ArcLight Fund VI owns ArcLight Orca Holdings.

Olympus subsidiaries hold the remaining Class A and all Class B interests.
